At the age of 65, I finally decided to pursue something I had always dreamed of—learning music. I came across Anway Sir's music classes and thought I'd give them a try. Looking back after more than six months, I can confidently say it has been one of the most fulfilling decisions I've made.

The biggest reason for this wonderful experience is Anway Sir himself. He is an exceptionally calm, patient, passionate and knowledgeable teacher who genuinely enjoys sharing his love for music with anyone eager to learn. What I admire most is his ability to simplify even the most technical concepts, making them easy to understand and enjoyable to practice, regardless of age or prior experience.

Every class is filled with positive energy, encouragement and warmth, making learning a truly joyful experience. I always look forward to my sessions and leave each one feeling inspired and motivated to keep improving.

Anway Sir hasn't just taught me music—he has opened the door to a beautiful new journey that I hope to continue for many years to come. I am deeply grateful for his guidance, patience and unwavering support.

Thank you, Sir, for helping me fulfil a lifelong dream. Wishing you continued success and many more years of inspiring music lovers. Stay blessed!
